_doc: Hand-curated JUDGEMENT for scripts/handoffs/backlog_priority.py - never live state. entries: one per box, matched by row + token in the first 110 chars of the box text (an entry that matches no open box counts toward curated_unmatched; `--check` fails above 5 %, so prune ticked/moved entries). Fields: kind I|N|O (judgement override of the classifier), s 0..1 (decision value inside its band), why, unblocks (prose, display only), size (estimate), before ('ROW:TOKEN' of the curated entry this box must land before, or 'filler:<id>[,<id>]' for FILLERS rows; the ONLY curated way to say a box gates compute), fillers ([FILLERS ids this box is the decision for] - an identity link, the STATUS comes from queue_status.py), hold (optional lifting condition for a box the curator knows is held and the patterns below cannot see). NOT here any more: cls/live/ready, blocker, owner, done, in_progress, synthetic 'new' entries - live compute state comes from queue_status.py + FILLERS.md, completion from the box being ticked, owner from the box text / FILLERS owner column. row_weights: per-row judgement used for tie-breaks. park_rows: PARKED/FROZEN files (the only row-level holds), each with its lifting condition. holds: box-level holds, applied only to boxes matching the hold's own pattern (and `kinds`, `rows`), each with its lifting condition; `inherit` passes a hold from a parent box to its children. briefs: dispatch briefs keyed by the box token. done_pending_tick: a completion claim the owning session has not ticked yet (row, tok, done=reason). The box is excluded from dispatch and listed in the file; once the box is ticked the entry is stale and is reported as done_stale (prune it). The ONLY completion state kept here, because the generator must never send a subagent to redo finished work.
